verdict.rationale: Kling documents a public RESTful API with JWT authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey), published global and China endpoints, a production quickstart, and a dated /v1 API changelog with model-version parameters across 239 documented pages, so the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI artifact (kling.ai/openapi.json serves the app shell, and the reference has no interactive try-it), and no independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
Add model_name parameter to distinguish model versions, default kling-v2-6
